pageReviews.summary: 2 actionable findings were found. Main risk: the R6 ballot4 Foundation Module roadmap may be stale after R6 normative-status edits, and it contains visible editorial placeholders.

findings.title: Subscription roadmap status appears stale after R6 normative changes

evidence.label: foundation-module action file
evidence.quote: `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:106-110` says Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic are “undergoing trial use.” Commit `270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd` / PR #3901 changed each corresponding StructureDefinition `structuredefinition-standards-status` from `trial-use` to `normative`.

narrative.analysis:
H-001: Subscription roadmap status appears stale after R6 normative changes

Evidence: `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:106-110` says Subscription, SubscriptionStatus, and SubscriptionTopic are “undergoing trial use.” Commit `270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd` / PR #3901 changed each corresponding StructureDefinition `structuredefinition-standards-status` from `trial-use` to `normative`.

Problem: The page’s roadmap language may no longer match current R6 source metadata.

Why it matters: Readers may get conflicting maturity/status signals for Subscription resources.

Recommended next step: Ask FHIR-I to decide whether the resource metadata or the roadmap prose should be updated before publication.

Intent-vs-implementation context: H-001.

limitations: - Caveats: local source is not rendered HTML; resource hrefs are generated by the publisher rather than existing as top-level source `.html` files. Several PR bodies were template-only and did not name Jira issues. The 2023 roadmap Zulip thread is strong timing/context evidence but does not explicitly mention `foundation-module.html`; avoid claiming it caused the page edit.

- `bun run zulip:search fts "\"FHIR-23738\""` and analogous key/phrase searches; snapshots for `where's the R5 specs?`, `Posted model changes`, `FHIR-I Call 2020-04-27`, `FMM levels`, and `Agenda item for June 24 call`: established discussion context and key failed search (`FHIR-38865` absent in Zulip).

findings.title: Roadmap prose has a typo and empty placeholders

evidence.label: foundation-module action file
evidence.quote: `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:104` says “here have been significant redesigns”; `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:108-110` renders `Subscription:`, `SubscriptionStatus:`, and `SubscriptionTopic:` with no text after the colons.

narrative.analysis:
E-001: Roadmap prose has a typo and empty placeholders

Evidence: `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:104` says “here have been significant redesigns”; `fhir-spec-search/trees/source/hl7.fhir.core/6.0.0-ballot4-5d67a34a13a5/source/foundation-module.html:108-110` renders `Subscription:`, `SubscriptionStatus:`, and `SubscriptionTopic:` with no text after the colons.

Problem: The roadmap looks unfinished.

Why it matters: It reduces confidence in the maturity guidance on the page.

Recommended next step: Fix “here” to “there” and either add descriptions after the colons or remove the colons.
